title: Can I BEAT Leela Piece Odds?
summary: Tony plays the lichess bot 'LeelaPieceOdds', an engine that gives material odds across 14 levels (level 1: no queen and no rooks ... level 14: two-knight odds). Wins level 1 and level 2, skips to level 9 (missing both knights and a rook; has queen and bishop pair) and is stalemated in a winning time scramble (~8:56), then tries level 12 (missing a rook and a knight) with increment and loses (~18:55).
rules: Standard chess vs an engine that starts with missing pieces chosen by level.

14 levels: level 1 = queen + both rooks odds; level 2 similar (queen + two rooks variant); level 9 = both knights + one rook missing; level 12 = one rook + one knight missing; level 14 = two knights odds (top levels give the least material).
Player progresses up levels; stalemate/draw counts as not winning.
win_condition: Checkmate Leela at as high a level as possible (won L1, L2; stalemated L9; lost L12).

board.theme_notes: lichess green board; result panels 'Checkmate - White is victorious', 'Stalemate'

setup: Level 1: rnb1kbn1/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQ - 0 1 (Leela missing queen + both rooks; player White). Other levels remove the listed pieces.
current_impl_issues: Impl 'botodds' n=1 with a slider; should reflect the 14-level ladder with specific missing-piece sets (Q+RR at L1 down to NN at L14) and a strong engine.
evidence: Own srt: 00:01 '14 levels starting with queen and rook odds all the way up to two knight odds'; 00:11 'does not have its queen or either of its rooks'; 02:12 win L1; 03:30 'level nine... missing both of its knights as well as a rook'; 08:56 stalemate; 09:58 'level 12 out of 14... missing a rook and a knight'; 18:55 'we do lose against Leela'. Frame visual_d lichess LeelaPieceOdds.
